title: WHAT IF YOU HAD TO REACH THE OIL RIG?
idea: A journey: every part is a NEW location so viewers never get bored. Lots of action (chases, jumps, decoys) + 1-3 real survival facts per part on paper cards.
rule: Only make the next part AFTER the user sends the poll result. Part N+1 opens with 'X% of you said ...' (scene: voted) then continues from the winning choice.
route_ideas: Part 1: apartment -> city streets (car-alarm decoy) -> rooftop chase -> harbor at dawn
Part 2: open sea (swim or fishing boat) - cold water, fuel, navigation
Part 3: reaching the rig - climbing up, who's on it
Part 4-6: rig life + new threats (storm, raiders, supply run to a ship/island)

history.question: Jump in and swim for the last boat, OR take the fishing boat with half a tank
history.poll_result: Take the fishing boat (most of you; no % given)

history.question: Climb onto the drifting sailboat, OR row toward the fog horn with the oars
